caption: The video captures a grassy park at dusk, where a pale sunset sky glows behind leafless trees, a fence line, mist over water and low hills. A very large, thin iridescent soap-bubble film already floats in the foreground, its rounded rainbow body on the left and a long tapering tail stretching toward the right, while a few small round bubbles rest on the grass below. Over the first frames the film alone slowly deforms, the left body reshaping and the tail changing curvature as its colors drift. A thin wand string then appears at the right edge, followed by a person's arm and two wand sticks entering from the far right. The person becomes fully visible, holding the raised wand aloft. They then translate leftward across the grass from the right edge toward the center-right. As the person moves, the film's tail continues stretching to the right and its body keeps reshaping. The small ground bubbles and the background scenery remain essentially stationary throughout.
